name.description: lowercase display name used for matching against detected elements

aliases.description: optional plain-English synonyms to match against, for symbols (esp. gestures) whose formal name a vision model is unlikely to phrase verbatim

meaning.description: standalone explanation of this symbol, true regardless of which figure it appears with

tradition.description: optional: set ONLY when this symbol is genuinely specific to one tradition (e.g. a Latin-only devotional object, or an Eastern icon convention). Most symbols apply to both and should leave this unset. Used as a tie-breaker in matching, not a hard filter.

figures.description: optional context: which Christian figures/scenes this symbol is commonly associated with

generic.description: true when this is a broad class of picture or person (e.g. 'Saints generally') rather than a nameable subject. Shown as card context, but never offered as a figure identification.
